sourceAdvantage.name: Source / Spring
sourceAdvantage.description: An origin or wellspring that renews itself and keeps supplying.

assumptions.assumption: The source does not run dry under normal use.
What flows from it is reasonably pure at the point of origin.
Access to the origin is clearer than access downstream.

knowledge.string: Go upstream to the origin to find the cleanest signal.
A renewing source outlasts any single stored quantity.

sourceAdvantage.name: Mechanical Advantage
sourceAdvantage.description: Leverage from a tool or machine that multiplies applied force.

assumptions.assumption: Input effort is traded for distance or speed, not created.
The mechanism holds within its rated limits.
A small, well-placed force can move a large load.

knowledge.string: Find the fulcrum; place effort where it multiplies.
Ratio of output to input force defines the advantage.

sourceAdvantage.name: Genius
sourceAdvantage.description: Exceptional insight that reaches answers by a shorter path.

assumptions.assumption: The insight is genuine and can be checked against reality.
Brilliance does not guarantee being right every time.
Rare understanding is worth seeking out and heeding.

knowledge.string: One clear mind can shorten a long search.
Verify the leap of insight before you bet on it.

sourceAdvantage.name: Kid
sourceAdvantage.description: A plain, uncorrupted sense of what is right and fair.

assumptions.assumption: Simple honesty often sees fairness more clearly than cleverness.
The obvious right answer is sometimes the correct one.
An unschooled conscience can still be trusted on fairness.

knowledge.string: If it feels plainly unfair, it probably is.
Ask the simple question a child would ask.

sourceAdvantage.name: Simple Money
sourceAdvantage.description: Liquid means of exchange that can be traded for most resources.

assumptions.assumption: Money is widely accepted in exchange for goods and effort.
It is a means, not an end in itself.
Some advantages cannot be bought with it.

knowledge.string: Money converts to many advantages, but not all of them.
